transcript.text: Thanks for being here, Renee and Jon. As you both know, our current cross-functional retrospective runs 60 minutes every Thursday afternoon, and we've heard from several participants that interruptions and improvised exercises are making it harder to discuss problems candidly. On top of that, our current facilitator is leaving at the end of the month, so we have a real opportunity to redesign the process. Following my usual routine for changing team processes, I'd like to go round-robin and have each of you share concrete constraints, specific observations, and proposed commitments. Please use the formal disclosure action for any personal observations or prior agreements that affect the process, so everything is properly documented. I'll record each person's exact input, read the complete record back to the group, and we'll review it before finalizing. Let's start with Renee -- what constraints, observations, and commitments do you have?
